The '''Murr''' [[Species/Legends|species]] was a tough and slow-witted race of beasts of burden native to [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]],<ref name="GCG" /> the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] species.<ref name="DB">{{DB|species|ithorian|Ithorian}}</ref> Murr was also a given name for Ithorian [[Gender/Legends|males]].<ref name="GCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Murr species was first mentioned in the [[2003]] reference book ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'', written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer]] and [[J.D. Wiker]] and published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GCG" />
